used.reason: Delaware Blue Hens offense +0.173 (7 games) vs Kennesaw State Owls defense allowed +0.181 (7 games); Kennesaw State Owls offense +0.103 (7 games) vs Delaware Blue Hens defense allowed +0.189 (7 games); CFBD PPA Delaware Blue Hens: offense +0.124 (7 games), defense allowed +0.200 (7 games); CFBD PPA Kennesaw State Owls: offense +0.019 (7 games), defense allowed +0.159 (7 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

cfbd.label: CFBD PPA
cfbd.note: Equal-game averages of prior-week CFBD PPA/play; offense higher / defense allowed lower. Independent provider cross-check, correlated with EPA, not an extra probability boost. Missing games remain unknown; season aggregate is not used for historical cutoffs.

used.reason: UCLA Bruins offense +0.150 (8 games) vs Minnesota Golden Gophers defense allowed +0.061 (7 games); Minnesota Golden Gophers offense -0.024 (7 games) vs UCLA Bruins defense allowed -0.156 (8 games); CFBD PPA UCLA Bruins: offense +0.155 (8 games), defense allowed -0.223 (8 games); CFBD PPA Minnesota Golden Gophers: offense -0.040 (7 games), defense allowed +0.030 (7 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

CFBD UCLA Bruins: offense gap +0.195 PPA/play (higher better), defense-allowed gap -0.253 (lower better). No joint offense/defense disadvantage at the 0.05 thresholds; original edge requirement retained.

cfbd.note: Equal-game averages of prior-week CFBD PPA/play; offense higher / defense allowed lower. Independent provider cross-check, correlated with EPA, not an extra probability boost. Missing games remain unknown; season aggregate is not used for historical cutoffs.

used.reason: Virginia Tech Hokies offense +0.200 (7 games) vs SMU Mustangs defense allowed +0.170 (7 games); SMU Mustangs offense +0.215 (7 games) vs Virginia Tech Hokies defense allowed +0.061 (7 games); CFBD PPA Virginia Tech Hokies: offense +0.166 (7 games), defense allowed +0.119 (7 games); CFBD PPA SMU Mustangs: offense +0.214 (7 games), defense allowed +0.133 (7 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

cfbd.label: CFBD PPA
cfbd.note: Equal-game averages of prior-week CFBD PPA/play; offense higher / defense allowed lower. Independent provider cross-check, correlated with EPA, not an extra probability boost. Missing games remain unknown; season aggregate is not used for historical cutoffs.

used.reason: TCU Horned Frogs offense +0.046 (7 games) vs Arizona Wildcats defense allowed +0.124 (7 games); Arizona Wildcats offense +0.239 (7 games) vs TCU Horned Frogs defense allowed +0.010 (7 games); CFBD PPA TCU Horned Frogs: offense +0.020 (7 games), defense allowed -0.066 (7 games); CFBD PPA Arizona Wildcats: offense +0.273 (7 games), defense allowed +0.014 (7 games). Offensive EPA: higher is better. Defensive EPA allowed: lower is better; negative is favorable. These are equal-game averages of non-garbage-time EPA/play, not opponent-adjusted ratings. The existing CFB spread forecast already uses opponent-adjusted EPA alongside other metrics; do not add these descriptive averages to its probability again. Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. Check sample, opponent strength, injuries and pace; EPA alone is not a spread, total, player projection or bet instruction. Source: local ESPN-derived EPA, not CFBD PPA; provider values are not interchangeable.

ignored: CFBD policy: totals/player props need a separate validated projection rule

Passing/rushing are context, not a separately validated matchup edge. Missing values mean unknown. The bottom quarter of losing members with at least 10 games moves to research; at least four experienced members are needed and held seats count toward the quota. Reassigned researchers pause new bets in both competitions. Three proven founders are required for a new office: each 200 games / 60 dates and positive conservative returns, plus 50 forward original-strategy games / 14 dates after policy activation. Existing offices and all history remain. Return from research requires forward validation and half-unit sportsbook probation. Agency rewards are paper progression credits, not betting cash or real money.

data_access.note: Rule-based agents query shared NBA API/nflverse snapshots. Queries are timestamped and hashed; they do not invoke an LLM or access arbitrary websites.

prop_research.note: One frozen specialist-selected contract per player/stat/game. Owner and leave-one-book-out consensus are paired benchmarks, not separate portfolios. All eligible forecasts and passes are scored; candidate returns are hypothetical units. Usage is a shot/turnover proxy, not official USG%. Conditional on playing; missing results stay unknown. References are not certified CLV.

research_desk.note: Actual recorded history analysis and decision-time reads. Movements visualize records, never create bets. WATCH is information only; a negative segment can cap stakes, never raise them. Reports expire after seven days.

policy: Sportsbook agency concentration: each same-game directional opinion may commit at most 0.25% of the members’ combined conservative bankroll basis, with a floor of one member’s 1% ticket allowance. Same-team spread and moneyline stakes count together across books and line changes. Totals and each player/stat direction have separate buckets; opposing stakes never offset each other. Current open tickets consume room, including retained acceptance-agency exposure after a member moves. Existing tickets keep their terms. This caps copies; it does not force opposite bets or create independent forecasts. New paper stakes: at most 40% committed overall, 10% per sport, 2% per game and 1% per ticket. At most 10% committed beyond 24 hours. Sportsbook NBA/NFL game lines may use 7.5% per sport, leaving 2.5% of bankroll for props within the 10% sport limit. Percentages use the lower of initial bankroll and current cash plus open stakes; profits do not automatically increase limits. Existing locked tickets remain intact, and may exceed new limits until settlement. Model and sportsbook accounts stay separate. Separate $10,000 paper bankrolls. One ticket per agent/game/market (player props: per player and stat, settled only from official box scores; did-not-play props are void and refunded); additional existing unit and prop sub-limits also apply. Quotes must be <=90 minutes old, saved before acceptance and before tip. Soccer three-way winners grade draws as wins only for the draw selection; supported half-line totals and full-game two-way markets retain their contracts. Uncalibrated strategy assumptions; no real wagers.
